messages:
maya: FYI prepping QBR for NovaHealth - big embedding surge last week, want a short runbook + spend forecast for renewal call.
billing-bot: Alert: account novahealth (acct id: nova-123) crossed 750k embedding tokens in last 7d. Projected 3.1M/mo at current rate.
ojas: wow. Do we know what's driving it? model / vector size / batching?
maya: customer rolled out "content-similarity" v2. It's calling embeddings per page commit. Sample call: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"embed-3","input":["...document text..."]}'```
ayana: I did a quick probe last night - avg tokens per embed ~150, batch size 1. We'll advise increasing batch to 8 and switching to embed-3-small for less precision.
samir: For QBR numbers, finance needs committed vs overage and 3 scenarios (conservative/likely/high). I can draft with your inputs, @maya @ayana.
maya: Timeline: QBR in ~48h. Need forecast + slide. Also want enablement checklist: throttles, sample configs, cost-saver playbook.
ayana: I'll produce a 1-pager with: batching examples, sample SDK config, TTL cache note, and snippet to compute cost per 1k vectors.
finance-ops: FYI, renewal team prefers a $/monthly token burn chart and threshold alerts. Can you supply daily burn export by EOD?
maya: Uploading logs now: https://s3.console.aws/example-bucket/novahealth/embeds-logs-2026-03-19.ndjson
ojas: I'll run a quick estimate script and post numbers. Plan: simulate 3 scenarios and suggested quota caps + alert thresholds.
billing-bot: Projection job queued (job id: proj-998). ETA ~15m.
maya: If projection confirms runway risk, we'll pre-empt with a "burst protect" offer and an enablement session. @ayana can lead.
ayana: Yep - available slots: 9am or 2pm PT tomorrow. I'll prep slides + template code.
samir: I'll draft the cost slide + renewal messaging. @finance-ops can you confirm overage pricing tiers for embed-3 vs embed-3-small?
finance-ops: embed-3 = $0.0008/token, embed-3-small = $0.00035/token. Also we can offer a temporary commit uplift for burst protection.
maya: Great. Action items: ayana - 1pager & enablement; ojas - scenario numbers; samir - slides; finance-ops - confirm pricing + commit uplift. Will sync 30m before QBR.
maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
